title: Turning tracking on gives the part a default bin with quantity zero
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. An untracked part (some with no bin, some with bins but no default).
custom_steps:
1. Open an untracked part with no bin in Edit Inventory Part and turn tracking on; check the bin it gains, its quantity and default flag.
  2. Repeat on a part that has bins but no default; check which bin becomes default.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The tracking toggle is enabled in edit mode; turning tracking on when the part has no bin gives it the workplace's default bin location, created with quantity zero and marked as the default bin.
  • Turning tracking on when the part has bins but no default marks the first one as the default.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 5 (Edit tracking state); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R1: “The "Track quantities and cost of goods" toggle is enabled in edit mode, the user can change the tracking state of an existing part.”
  • S5-R2: “When the user turns tracking on and the part has no bin location, the system gives it the workplace's default bin location.”
  • S5-R3: “That bin location is created with a quantity of zero.”
  • S5-R4: “That bin location is marked as the default bin.”
  • S5-R5: “When the user turns tracking on and the part has bin locations but none is the default, the system marks the first one as the default.”
